title: P1: bus.create_task drops a fix round's own parent from depends_on
spec: Goal T-1383. orchestrator/bus.py create_task (bus.py:101): when constraints.fix_round_for is set and depends_on contains that same id, remove it from depends_on before saving and append a task event noting the normalization (e.g. _event(id, "depends_on_normalized", {"dropped": parent})). Other depends_on entries are kept. Why: bus.ready (bus.py:140) requires every dependency to have merged_into, and a held parent only becomes merged when its fix round merges (daemon.py report_merge walks fix_round_for), so a fix round that depends on its parent can never dispatch; headless Planners filed four such tasks in luna-inbox on 2026-09-24. Tests in tests/test_bus.py (unittest.TestCase methods): a fix round created with depends_on=[parent, other] keeps [other] and is ready once other is merged; a normal task keeps its depends_on unchanged; the normalization event is recorded.
